text:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 1: Polarsys marketplace launch next month. They want a co-branded solution card, two sticker sizes (laptop + box seal), and a one-page case summary for marketplace listing. Need approvals on logo placement and compliance copy by Tuesday.
Diego (Design): Dropped mockups in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/polarsys/creative. Key callouts: use horizontal lockup on the card, desktop sticker = 70x20mm, box seal = 40x40mm rounded. Will provide print-ready PDFs once legal okays copy.
Maya (Partnerships): @Priya can Polarsys add their reseller mark next to our logo on the card? Also any required trademark footers?
Priya (Legal): They can add the mark but not alter our mark or use it as an endorsement. Required footer: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Labs, Inc. Used under license." Also include a short IP disclaimer: "No offer of joint product ownership." Send final mock for sign-off.
Ethan (Marketing): For the marketplace tile we need three crops: 1) hero 1200x628, 2) square 800x800, 3) thumbnail 400x240. Alt copy suggestion: "Redwood Inference on Polarsys hardware: efficient LLM serving". Keep headline: "Redwood + Polarsys: Edge-ready inference".
Hana (HW PM): Manufacturing needs print-ready PDFs by Wed EOD. Printer requires 3mm bleed and dielines. Also confirm adhesive spec for box seals (low-temp shipping).
Diego (Design): Noted bleed 3mm. Also asking: for the co-brand lockup, Polarsys requested equal visual weight. We prefer Redwood primary; suggest side-by-side with divider. Mocking both symmetrical and Redwood-dominant options.
Maya (Partnerships): @AssetBot please attach the Polarsys brand guide we got last week so design + legal can cross-check spacing rules.
AssetBot: Attached: polarsys-brand-guidelines-2026.pdf, polarsys-reseller-badge.eps
Priya (Legal): Flag: Polarsys wants to use the phrase "certified for Redwood" on their marketing copy. That's okay but we need a short acceptance clause: "Certification indicates compatibility and not endorsement." Also include trademark line for them.
Ethan (Marketing): Also need a 1-page case summary. Draft blurb: "Redwood reduces inference cost on Polarsys edge appliances by up to 56% via batching and KV caching." Can someone validate the percent? We should avoid exact numbers without eval backing.
Maya (Partnerships): Remove exact percent for now. Use: "significant cost and latency improvements". We'll provide a validated stat after QA.
Hana (HW PM): On SKU: marketplace requires an SKU field and a short URL. I created SKU PS-REDWOOD-EDGE-001. Confirm before publishing.
Diego (Design): Uploaded mock v2: https://drive.redwood/polarsys/creative/mock_v2_print.pdf. Added both lockup options and placed dielines. Please review with :eyes:.
Priya (Legal): Reviewing mock v2 now. Small edit: move Polarsys reseller badge 6mm away from our clearspace. Also remove the phrase "built with" from the quickstart card.
Ethan (Marketing): I'll polish the case summary language and provide alt text variants. Suggest alt: "Polarsys rack with Redwood badge" and SEO tag: "edge inference, LLM serving".
Maya (Partnerships): Timeline recap: 1) Diego -> final PDFs for sticker + card + marketplace crops by Wed 3pm PT; 2) Priya -> legal sign-off on mock by Thu morning; 3) Ethan -> final case copy + SKU confirmation by Wed EOD; 4) Hana -> confirm pickup/print slot once PDFs are final. If anyone misses a deadline call it out now.
Hana (HW PM): Printer slot tentatively booked Thu-Fri. Need sign-off Wed COB to keep slot.
Diego (Design): Will deliver PDFs by Wed 2pm PT.
Priya (Legal): Will sign off Thu 10am PT max.
Ethan (Marketing): Confirm SKU PS-REDWOOD-EDGE-001 and short URL short.redwood/ps-edge. Updating case copy now.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll compile final asset checklist and send to the vendor when legal sign-off comes through.
Diego (Design): One last UI question for marketplace: Polarsys wants the Redwood logo in the product screenshot overlay. We should only do a small badge in the corner to avoid obscuring UI. Mocked that in v2.
Priya (Legal): Agree small badge ok. Do not include any language implying joint development.
Maya (Partnerships): Closing the thread after final sign-offs. I'll post the vendor PO and pickup details once printed. :package:
